div.div:
pollinctor (or pollictor ), ōris, m. pollingo,
I.one who washes corpses and prepares them for burning, an undertaker: “pollinctores sunt, qui mortuos curant,” Non. 157, 20 ; cf.: “pollinctores dicti sunt, qui funera morientium accurant,” Fulg. p. 559, 9 ; Plaut. Poen. prol. 63; id. As. 5, 2, 60; Varr. ap. Non. 157, 21 sq.; Mart. 10, 97, 3; Dig. 14, 3, 5; Sid. Ep. 3, 13; of buriers, Vulg. Ezech. 39, 15.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
